tool_name.description: Tool name to use for reviewdog reporter

reporter.description:
Reporter of reviewdog command [github-pr-check,github-pr-review,github-check].
Default is github-pr-check.
github-pr-review can use Markdown and add a link to r

filter_mode.description:
Filtering mode for the reviewdog command [added,diff_context,file,nofilter].
Default is file.

fail_level.description: If set to `none`, always use exit code 0 for reviewdog. Otherwise, exit code 1 for reviewdog if it finds at least 1 issue with severity greater than or equal to

fail_on_error.description:
Deprecated, use `fail_level` instead.
Exit code for reviewdog when errors are found [true,false]
Default is `false`.
